angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,057,464 km at 246.62 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.0549 +/- 0.0099 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 246.62 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.52 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Turner et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KELT-14 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016PASP..128f4401T/abstract): 1,057,464 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.239 +/- 0.039 solar masses from Turner et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KELT-14 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016PASP..128f4401T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5720 +/- 130 K from Turner et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-14 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016PASP..128f4401T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Turner et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-14 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016PASP..128f4401T/abstract)

objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-42 3043: main object type *, Star

luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-14 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.27875, from Rodriguez et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....151..138R/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-14 (pscomppars): age 5.11 Gyr, from Turner et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016PASP..128f4401T/abstract)
